summary:
I found the "needle"—it was an off-by-one array slicing bug in `processor.py`.

In Python, slice indices are end-exclusive, but the code was computing:
```python
end = start + batch_size - 1
```
This was dropping one item at the boundary of every processed batch.

### The Fix
I corrected the end-index calculation in `processor.py`:
```python
end = start + batch_size  # end is exclusive in Python slice
```

### Verification
Running `test.sh` now completes successfully:
```bash
PASS: All records processed correctly across batch boundaries
```
